description: This file defines the PagedList class, a generic container used to hold a subset of data items along with pagination metadata, such as start/end indices, total size, and view parameters. It is used for paginating query results or data collections in the project.

classes.name: PagedList
classes.description: A generic class representing a paginated list of data items along with pagination metadata such as start/end indices and total size.

methods.name: PagedList
methods.description: Constructor to initialize all pagination fields and the data list.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Static method to create an empty PagedList with specified view parameters.

methods.name: getStartIndex
methods.description: Returns the starting index of the paginated segment.

methods.name: getEndIndex
methods.description: Returns the ending index of the paginated segment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the full dataset.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the list of data items in this page.

methods.name: getViewIndex
methods.description: Returns the view index specified by the client.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns the view size specified by the client.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the data items in this paged list.
